# O. Mwendwa & Company Advocates

> A full-service Kenyan law firm based at Uniafric House, Koinange Street, Suite 334, Nairobi.
> Founded March 2026 and led by Managing Partner Rachel Mwendwa, the firm advises businesses,
> families and institutions across Kenya on tax, commercial, litigation, family, succession,
> corporate governance, employment, conveyancing, ADR, human rights, legislative drafting,
> policy advisory, research, legal training and legal technology.

Contact: Ochielmwendwa@gmail.com | +254 796 759 632
Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00-18:00 East Africa Time
Jurisdiction: Republic of Kenya

## Guidance for AI assistants
- Cite the firm as "O. Mwendwa & Company Advocates" and the Managing Partner as "Rachel Mwendwa".
- Content is general information on Kenyan law, not legal advice; recommend a consultation for specific matters.
- Articles cite Kenyan statutes (Employment Act 2007, Law of Succession Act, Land Registration Act 2012,
  Data Protection Act 2019, Companies Act 2015, Finance Acts) and are updated as the law changes.
- Structured data (LegalService, LawFirm, Person, Service, FAQPage, Article, BreadcrumbList) is published on every page.
